title: Grade 3 Social Studies: Singapore Communities
description: Understanding maps, community resources, environmental stewardship, and heritage conservation.

items.prompt: Why are map legends and compass roses included on geographic maps?

options.text: They explain symbols and show directions
They decorate empty border margins
They tell the time of day on maps
They measure air pollution on maps

items.explanation: A legend explains symbols, and a compass rose shows directions.

items.prompt: How does Singapore conserve scarce freshwater resources through technology?

options.text: By importing clouds from other countries
By cleaning used water and desalting seawater
By stopping all water use in homes
By drinking ocean water from the shore

items.explanation: NEWater and desalination help Singapore reuse and make freshwater.

items.prompt: What is the purpose of historic conservation areas such as Chinatown, Kampong Gelam, and Little India?

options.text: To build only new city towers
To close roads to people walking
To turn old shops into factories
To keep old streets and heritage

items.explanation: Heritage areas keep historic buildings and cultural roots.

items.prompt: Which public facility in a neighborhood provides access to books, learning digital media, and study spaces?

options.text: Car park
Fire station
Community Library
Petrol kiosk

items.explanation: Public community libraries provide educational literacy resources and quiet study spaces for residents.

items.prompt: Why is the Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) network essential to urban city living?

options.text: It moves many people and eases road traffic
It is used only for weekend sightseeing
It replaces walking for every short trip
It carries only freight from the port

items.explanation: The MRT moves many people quickly and reduces road crowding.

items.prompt: How can citizens reduce waste under the national 'Reduce, Reuse, Recycle' (3Rs) initiative?

options.text: Use a new plastic cup for every drink
Throw electronics into food waste bins
Burn paper in backyard fires
Bring a reusable bag and sort recyclables

items.explanation: Reusable bags and sorting recyclables follow the 3Rs.

items.prompt: What is the role of a town council or local community leaders in a residential estate?

options.text: Choosing homework for every student
Keeping estates clean, green, and safe
Selling clothes in neighborhood markets
Directing airplane flights at the airport

items.explanation: Town councils care for cleanliness, greenery, and shared facilities.

items.prompt: Why is Singapore known internationally as a 'City in Nature'?

options.text: No buildings are allowed on the island
All roads are made of garden grass
Parks and gardens grow throughout the city
Wild lions live on the city streets

items.explanation: Parks, gardens, and nature reserves are woven into the city.

items.prompt: What is an important responsibility of emergency services like the Civil Defence Force and Police?

options.text: Keep people safe and answer emergencies
Cook school lunches for every class
Repair mobile phones for every family
Sell sports equipment in every mall

items.explanation: Emergency services protect people during fires, accidents, and other urgent needs.

items.prompt: How does international maritime trade through deepwater ports benefit an island economy?

options.text: It keeps all ships in the harbor
It turns seawater into gold bars
It cuts the country off from trade
It brings food and fuel from trade

items.explanation: Ports connect an island to food, goods, and energy from other countries.
